summary: The attempt-1 defect is fixed correctly and nothing else moved: the diff 8dd3273..762232b is CLAUDE.md only, every sentence in '## UI Controls' is now true as written and verified against the tree by grep and by reading both excepted files, no internal or cross-section contradiction survives, the exception's reason is honest (both option sets are literal closed unions, not data-driven), ESLint still errors on all four banned forms including inside the excepted directory, and all four gates are green at the exact expected counts.
gates: lint=0 type-check=0 test=0 build=0 web=30/210 (api=24/248, shared-utils=1/17) - all four run by me, counts match the expected baseline exactly
only_claude_md_changed: yes - git diff --name-only 8dd3273..762232b returns exactly one path, CLAUDE.md, so attempt 1's clean findings transfer unmodified. The whole textual delta is the '## UI Controls' rewrite (one overloaded bullet became three: app-wide ban, scoped mandate, named exception); the numeric-field, type=date, geometry and onCreate bullets are byte-identical to attempt 1. git diff --name-only e2c43a0..762232b is still the same 24-file slice attempt 1 reviewed, no file added or dropped.
every_claim_true: yes - no false claim. Ban (43): my greps of apps/web/src find zero <select>/<option>/<datalist> markup; the 11 'datalist' hits are comments, test names and guard-test string literals. Mandate scope (45): a picker here can only be native (zero), Radix Select (exactly 2 importers, both the named exception), Combobox (SalesOpsApp 17, auth/react.tsx 1, ProductDialog 1, LinkGeneratorForm 2) or DropdownMenu (SalesOpsApp :933 account menu and :1593 row actions, both action menus not value pickers) - inside the claimed scope nothing is on anything else, and the only three data-driven option lists in admin/finder (ProductDialog:107, LinkGeneratorForm:93,:105) are all Combobox, while PriceBandForm and AppDialog hold only Inputs. Exception (47): both paths correct, ProductDialog.tsx:132 status and CommissionRuleForm.tsx:94 basis read as described. Numeric (50-51): 19 type=number sites, all on <Input> (lint proves it), base-layer rule really is inside @layer base at index.css:87-95. type=date (52): 3 sites, all <Input type="date">, and line 43 bans three named elements rather than claiming 'no native picker anywhere', so the two are consistent - the near-miss contradiction the implementer reports catching is genuinely absent from the shipped text. Geometry (53-54): comboboxTriggerClass h-10 at :156, formSelectClass adds h-11 at :164, formInputClass is h-11 too; 17 Combobox sites = 17 geometry-class usages, comboboxTriggerClass used only at :1061,:1076 both inside the single filtersOpen/vendas Filtros bar, and the only wrapped call sites are cn(formSelectClass,'bg-white') at :3131,:3191 which is non-geometry. onCreate (55-57): walked all 17 sites - cliente/area go through the API, prestador/profissional write the typed name verbatim, produto routes to onCreateProduct -> setModal prefillName at :1239, vendedor and finder carry no onCreate.
internal_contradictions: none. Ban vs type=date: consistent (a date input is not select/option/datalist). Mandate vs exception: consistent, because the mandate is scoped and 'only searchable picker' is a property a Radix Select does not have. 'the only one' vs 'do not add a third such site': consistent and true today (only 2 files import @/components/ui/select). Mandate scope vs geometry scope: consistent and necessarily so - auth/react.tsx:240 passes its own h-9 trigger class, which would break the 'exactly two canonical sizes' bullet if that bullet were not itself scoped to sales-ops, so the scoping is load-bearing rather than hedging. No conflict with the rest of CLAUDE.md either: line 63's 'Nivel de visualizacao selector was removed' still holds (the only occurrence in apps/web/src is a negative assertion at routing.test.tsx:334), and line 78's 'product Tipo was removed from the UI' is not contradicted by the Combobox at SalesOpsApp.tsx:3129, which is a module type (Modulo/Upsell/Downsell/Cross-sell/Add-on), a different field. AGENTS.md states no UI-control rule, so no cross-document conflict.
exception_reason_accurate: yes - both really are closed enums. Neither option set is data-driven: each is two literal JSX SelectItem children, not a .map() over any query, prop or response, and each enumerates the full domain of a TypeScript union imported from @/admin/types - ProductStatus (active|archived) and CommissionBasis (quoted_net|list_net). The same ProductDialog file proves the distinction is drawn honestly rather than as a rationalization: its one genuinely data-driven picker, the apps list at :104-110 with options={(apps ?? []).map(...)}, IS a Combobox. So 'search buys nothing' is accurate, and the bullet is useful to a future agent because it also names the trigger and the action ('convert them whenever those two screens are next worked on, and do not add a third such site') rather than just recording the exemption.
eslint_still_enforces: yes, and the scope was not narrowed. Probe 1 (apps/web/src/__probe_verify06__.tsx) carried all four banned forms and produced 4 no-restricted-syntax errors with the intended messages, exit 1: <select>, <option>, <datalist>, raw <input type="number">. Probe 2 was placed deliberately in apps/web/src/admin/products/__probe2__/p.tsx - the same directory as the two excepted files - to prove the exception is documentation and not a lint escape hatch: 2 errors, exit 1. The rule block is files:['**/*.{ts,tsx}'] with only the top-level {ignores:['dist']}; the one ignores:['src/lib/app-mutation.ts'] in the config belongs to a separate later block carrying only no-restricted-imports and exempts nothing from the picker ban. No eslint-disable for no-restricted-syntax exists anywhere in apps/web/src, and eslint.config.js is the only ESLint config in the package (no .eslintrc* override). Both probes deleted.
hygiene_ok: yes - exactly 1 commit on the branch (git rev-list --count e2c43a0..762232b = 1); Conventional Commit subject 'feat(web): adopt the searchable Combobox everywhere and delete every native picker'; trailers empty, author and committer both CauetPinciara <cauetpinciara@gmail.com>, no co-author and no AI attribution (the sole case-insensitive 'claude' hit is the literal filename CLAUDE.md in the body, which the brief excludes); no em dash in any added line or in the commit message. Tree restored: git diff HEAD empty, git status showing the same four untracked entries present at start (.vscode/ plus the three prior nexo artifacts) and nothing else. I did not merge, push, commit or amend and stayed on feat/06-combobox-adoption.

(1) The create rows end to end against the real API - cadastros/produtos Area picker searching and its amber '+ Criar nova area "..."' row actually creating, and the Nova proposta Cliente create row producing a cliente that then appears in cadastros/clientes; everything below the onCreateClient/onCreateArea boundary is spy-mocked and only the transport was verified by reading. (2) The two CSS-only claims - no OS spin buttons on any number field including inside Radix Dialog portals, and the admin/finder Radix Select and DropdownMenu panels now having a real background where bg-popover emitted nothing. (3) Rendered pixel geometry, proven at class-token level only because happy-dom computes no Tailwind - eyeball an Itens row and a parcela row, the rows that move 40px -> 44px. (4) The inline non-portalled panel inside the two overflow-y-auto dialog bodies - opening the picker on the LAST parcela or LAST profissional row extends the dialog's scroll area instead of floating above it. (5) Two stacked Radix modals - the now-wired 'Cadastrar produto' button and the produto create row open ProductDialog while the wizard dialog is still open; confirm backdrop, focus trap, focus return, and that wizard state survives. (6) New, minor and pre-existing: SalesOpsApp.tsx:1044-1048 renders a static 'Julho 2026' chip with a ChevronDown and no dropdown behind it, so it looks clickable but is decoration.
